cases.why: an interval that reaches past zero is labelled ACCEPT, which is the exact claim the whole bootstrap exists to stop
a candidate no better than the incumbent on validation still reaches confirmation, spending a slot on a question the screen already answered
each week's model is fitted on that week's own games, so every Stage 5 number is scored on data the model has already seen, and every candidate looks better than it is
every confirmatory interval drops to 95% however many questions the family asks, which turns ten tests into a search that is expected to 'find' something by chance
the difference is taken incumbent-minus-candidate, so a worse candidate reads as an ACCEPT and a better one as a REJECT, with every number in the result file looking plausible
cases.find: d_ll, d_br = ll_c - ll_i, br_c - br_i
cases.replace: d_ll, d_br = ll_i - ll_c, br_i - br_c
